_doc: Generic prop classification (any book). A chapter prop name is matched by its words (lowercase): the first rule whose word list hits decides. physical props get a 3D model (tools/props_build.py) built on the library entry 'base' (affordances, proxy parts); 'states' words after a comma or before the base word ('Sword, heated', 'Dark Blue Sword') are STATES of that family (one mesh, material variants). mobility: fixed = anchored to the SET (the location's layout, never moved by the planner; a collider and support surface), movable = a state machine across the story (held-by / resting-on / carried / in), semi = carried or set down. joints = articulated parts (split from the mesh by a slab rule in the prop frame: axis + fraction of the bounding box).

_doc_flags: architectural: part of a WALL, never free-standing (scene_stage.mount_arch); opening_m [w, h] default size; sill_m: the opening's bottom height. work_support: a support a contact action works on (contact_actions.json); impact_fx / work_hot: what happens at its impact. offhand_for: a second-hand tool of that contact action, used only when the text names it. procedural: built by code, not image-to-3D (thin flexible props). rest: how a FIXED prop stands: long_horizontal (the long axis level: anvil, bench, table) | upright (architecture) | flat_base (default: its largest flat face down); props_bl writes rest_check to its json (QA). state_words entries: tint / emission / crack = a DERIVED state (the base mesh recoloured); shape: true = the state has its own shape (own picture + image-to-3D). soft: a draped / flexible prop (cloth, straps): no rigid rest pose, rest_check skipped. stand_m: the working height of a set prop's top (an anvil on its stump): the renderer adds a plain stump under a lower model.
